q: 我嗓子很疼，___今天不想说话。
zh: 我嗓子很疼，所以今天不想说话。
py: wǒ sǎng zi hěn téng suǒ yǐ jīn tiān bù xiǎng shuō huà
en: My throat really hurts, so I don't feel like talking today.
why: The first clause is a reason and the second its result, so 所以 comes before the second subject. 但是 would set up a contrast and 如果 a supposition, neither of which fits a plain cause.

q: ___保持身体健康，爷爷每天早上都去公园走路。
zh: 为了保持身体健康，爷爷每天早上都去公园走路。
py: wèi le bǎo chí shēn tǐ jiàn kāng yé ye měi tiān zǎo shang dōu qù gōng yuán zǒu lù
en: In order to stay healthy, Grandpa walks in the park every morning.
why: Staying healthy is the goal of the walking, not a cause that already happened, so 为了 is needed. 因为 would present it as a reason, and 如果 and 虽然 do not fit at all.

q: 既然你发烧了，___在家休息吧，别去上班了。
zh: 既然你发烧了，就在家休息吧，别去上班了。
py: jì rán nǐ fā shāo le jiù zài jiā xiū xi ba bié qù shàng bān le
en: Since you have a fever, rest at home and don't go to work.
why: 既然 (since, given that) leads to a suggestion with 就. 才 would mean "only then", and 但是 or 而且 would break the logical link between the fever and the advice.

q: 由于昨天晚上下了大雪，___今天学校放假了。
zh: 由于昨天晚上下了大雪，因此今天学校放假了。
py: yóu yú zuó tiān wǎn shang xià le dà xuě yīn cǐ jīn tiān xué xiào fàng jià le
en: Owing to the heavy snow last night, school is closed today.
why: 由于 gives the reason and 因此 states the result before the second subject. 虽然, 即使 and 只要 each open their own clause and do not introduce a result.

q: ___不感冒，孩子们出门前都要多穿一件衣服。
zh: 为了不感冒，孩子们出门前都要多穿一件衣服。
py: wèi le bù gǎn mào hái zi men chū mén qián dōu yào duō chuān yī jiàn yī fu
en: In order not to catch a cold, the children put on an extra layer before going out.
why: Not catching a cold is the aim of putting on more clothes, so 为了 is needed. The other three give a reason or a known fact and make no sense with a wish to avoid a cold.

q: ___你已经知道自己对花粉过敏，春天就应该少出门。
zh: 既然你已经知道自己对花粉过敏，春天就应该少出门。
py: jì rán nǐ yǐ jīng zhī dao zì jǐ duì huā fěn guò mǐn chūn tiān jiù yīng gāi shǎo chū mén
en: Since you already know you are allergic to pollen, you should go out less in spring.
why: 既然 states a known fact and takes 就 in the next clause. 即使 would need 也 and 虽然 would need 但是, while 只要 would turn the fact into a mere condition.

q: ___气温突然下降，___很多人感冒了。
zh: 由于气温突然下降，因此很多人感冒了。
py: yóu yú qì wēn tū rán xià jiàng yīn cǐ hěn duō rén gǎn mào le
en: Because the temperature suddenly dropped, many people caught colds.
why: 由于 gives the cause and 因此 the result. 虽然…但是 would contrast the two clauses, 如果…就 would make the cause hypothetical, and 不但…而且 would just add them.

q: 虽然今天很冷，___我还是想去游泳。
zh: 虽然今天很冷，但是我还是想去游泳。
py: suī rán jīn tiān hěn lěng dàn shì wǒ hái shì xiǎng qù yóu yǒng
en: Although it is cold today, I still want to go swimming.
why: 虽然 states a fact and the second clause needs 但是 even though English drops "but". 所以 and 因为 turn it into cause and effect, which does not fit the cold.

q: ___明天天气不好，我们也要去爬山。
zh: 即使明天天气不好，我们也要去爬山。
py: jí shǐ míng tiān tiān qì bù hǎo wǒ men yě yào qù pá shān
en: Even if the weather is bad tomorrow, we are going hiking.
why: 明天 is not yet a fact, so the supposed case needs 即使, which pairs with 也. 虽然 states something that has really happened, and 既然 and 因为 give reasons.

q: 他尽管发着高烧，___坚持把工作做完。
zh: 他尽管发着高烧，还是坚持把工作做完。
py: tā jǐn guǎn fā zhe gāo shāo hái shì jiān chí bǎ gōng zuò zuò wán
en: Even though he had a high fever, he still insisted on finishing the work.
why: 尽管 states a real fact and the second clause is a contrast marked by 还是 after the subject. 因此 would claim the fever caused the effort, and 只要 and 如果 start a condition.

q: ___医生已经一再提醒他少吃盐，他还是每顿饭都吃得很咸。
zh: 尽管医生已经一再提醒他少吃盐，他还是每顿饭都吃得很咸。
py: jǐn guǎn yī shēng yǐ jīng yī zài tí xǐng tā shǎo chī yán tā hái shì měi dùn fàn dōu chī de hěn xián
en: Even though the doctor has reminded him again and again to eat less salt, he still eats very salty food at every meal.
why: 已经 marks the reminding as a real fact, so 尽管 fits with 还是. 即使 is for a supposed case, and 因为 and 如果 do not match the contrast.

q: 就算明天下雨，我___要去上班。
zh: 就算明天下雨，我也要去上班。
py: jiù suàn míng tiān xià yǔ wǒ yě yào qù shàng bān
en: Even if it rains tomorrow, I still have to go to work.
why: 就算 supposes a case and takes 也 after the subject. 但是, 所以 and 因此 are conjunctions that do not belong with 就算.

q: ___他的腿还很疼，___他今天坚持来上课了。
zh: 虽然他的腿还很疼，但是他今天坚持来上课了。
py: suī rán tā de tuǐ hái hěn téng dàn shì tā jīn tiān jiān chí lái shàng kè le
en: Although his leg still hurts, he insisted on coming to class today.
why: The pain is a real fact and the second clause is a contrast, so 虽然…但是. 即使 would imagine the pain, and 因为…所以 or 如果…就 would turn it into a cause or a condition.

q: 他___每天都按时吃药，病却一直没有好。
zh: 他虽然每天都按时吃药，病却一直没有好。
py: tā suī rán měi tiān dōu àn shí chī yào bìng què yì zhí méi yǒu hǎo
en: Although he takes his medicine on time every day, he has not got better.
why: 每天都按时吃药 is a real fact and 却 marks the contrast, so 虽然 is right, placed after the subject. 即使 supposes, 只要 sets a condition and 既然 gives a reason.

q: ___明天你的感冒好了，医生也要你再休息两天。
zh: 即使明天你的感冒好了，医生也要你再休息两天。
py: jí shǐ míng tiān nǐ de gǎn mào hǎo le yī shēng yě yào nǐ zài xiū xi liǎng tiān
en: Even if your cold is better tomorrow, the doctor still wants you to rest two more days.
why: 明天你的感冒好了 has not happened yet, so it is a supposed case: 即使 with 也. 虽然 needs a fact that already holds, and 既然 and 因为 would be reasons.

q: 如果你头疼，我们___去医院看看。
zh: 如果你头疼，我们就去医院看看。
py: rú guǒ nǐ tóu téng wǒ men jiù qù yī yuàn kàn kàn
en: If you have a headache, we will go to the hospital and have a look.
why: 如果 takes 就 after the second subject. 才 would mean "only then", and 所以 or 但是 are conjunctions that do not match a condition.

q: 只有每天睡够八个小时，我___有精神。
zh: 只有每天睡够八个小时，我才有精神。
py: zhǐ yǒu měi tiān shuì gòu bā gè xiǎo shí wǒ cái yǒu jīng shén
en: Only if I sleep a full eight hours every day do I feel energetic.
why: 只有 names the one condition that works, so its partner is 才. 就 belongs with 只要 and 如果, and 都 or 还 do not pair with 只有.

q: 只要不下雨，我们___去公园玩。
zh: 只要不下雨，我们就去公园玩。
py: zhǐ yào bù xià yǔ wǒ men jiù qù gōng yuán wán
en: As long as it doesn't rain, we'll go to the park to play.
why: 只要 means this one condition is enough, so it takes 就. 才 is the partner of 只有, and 但是 and 所以 are conjunctions that cannot sit here.

q: 要是你对牛奶过敏的话，早餐___别喝牛奶了。
zh: 要是你对牛奶过敏的话，早餐就别喝牛奶了。
py: yào shì nǐ duì niú nǎi guò mǐn de huà zǎo cān jiù bié hē niú nǎi le
en: If you are allergic to milk, then don't drink milk at breakfast.
why: 要是…的话 leads to 就 in the next clause. 才 would change the meaning to "only then", and 所以 and 而是 do not fit a condition.

q: 只有医生同意了，他___能出院。
zh: 只有医生同意了，他才能出院。
py: zhǐ yǒu yī shēng tóng yì le tā cái néng chū yuàn
en: Only when the doctor agrees can he leave the hospital.
why: 只有 sets the only workable condition and takes 才. 就 is the partner of 只要, and 也 or 还 would add meaning that is not there.

q: 只要坚持锻炼，你的身体___会慢慢好起来的。
zh: 只要坚持锻炼，你的身体就会慢慢好起来的。
py: zhǐ yào jiān chí duàn liàn nǐ de shēn tǐ jiù huì màn màn hǎo qǐ lái de
en: As long as you keep exercising, your body will gradually get better.
why: 只要 means one thing is enough, so its partner is 就. 才 would make exercise the only way, which contradicts the cue, and 但是 and 虽然 are contrast words.

q: ___夏天一直这么热，我们___得装空调了。
zh: 如果夏天一直这么热，我们就得装空调了。
py: rú guǒ xià tiān yì zhí zhè me rè wǒ men jiù děi zhuāng kōng tiáo le
en: If summer stays this hot, we will have to put in an air conditioner.
why: 如果…就 sets a condition and its result. 虽然…但是 contrasts facts, 不但…而且 adds a second point, and 即使…也 would mean "we must anyway", which does not follow from the cue.

q: 不管天气怎么样，他每天___去跑步。
zh: 不管天气怎么样，他每天都去跑步。
py: bù guǎn tiān qì zěn me yàng tā měi tiān dōu qù pǎo bù
en: Whatever the weather is like, he goes running every day.
why: 不管 plus a question form takes 都 after the subject. 才 would mean "only then", and 但是 and 因此 are conjunctions that do not pair with 不管.

q: 无论冬天___夏天，奶奶都坚持早起散步。
zh: 无论冬天还是夏天，奶奶都坚持早起散步。
py: wú lùn dōng tiān hái shì xià tiān nǎi nai dōu jiān chí zǎo qǐ sàn bù
en: Whether it is winter or summer, Grandma gets up early for a walk.
why: After 无论 the question form here is A 还是 B, which gives the two open possibilities. 而且, 但是 and 所以 cannot link two alternatives.

q: 不管你身体好不好，医生___要你定期检查。
zh: 不管你身体好不好，医生都要你定期检查。
py: bù guǎn nǐ shēn tǐ hǎo bù hǎo yī shēng dōu yào nǐ dìng qī jiǎn chá
en: Whether or not you are in good health, the doctor wants you to have regular check-ups.
why: 不管 plus the A-not-A question 好不好 takes 都 in the second clause. 就 and 才 do not pair with 不管, and 但是 would contradict the idea.

q: 除了星期天，爸爸每天___去医院上班。
zh: 除了星期天，爸爸每天都去医院上班。
py: chú le xīng qī tiān bà ba měi tiān dōu qù yī yuàn shàng bān
en: Dad goes to work at the hospital every day except Sunday.
why: Sunday is left out, so 除了 pairs with 都. 还 and 也 would mean "besides Sunday, also", which makes no sense with 每天.

q: 除了感冒药，医生___给我开了一些维生素。
zh: 除了感冒药，医生还给我开了一些维生素。
py: chú le gǎn mào yào yī shēng hái gěi wǒ kāi le yī xiē wéi shēng sù
en: Besides the cold medicine, the doctor also prescribed me some vitamins.
why: Besides one item and adding another, 除了 pairs with 还. 都 would mean everything except the cold medicine, and 才 and 就 do not fit.

q: 除了我，家里人___喜欢吃辣的。
zh: 除了我，家里人都喜欢吃辣的。
py: chú le wǒ jiā lǐ rén dōu xǐ huan chī là de
en: Everyone in my family likes spicy food except me.
why: 除了 with 都 means "all but the one named", which fits the cue. 还 would mean "besides me, they also like it", the opposite of the cue.

q: 不管天气多么热，他___坚持每天跑五公里。
zh: 不管天气多么热，他都坚持每天跑五公里。
py: bù guǎn tiān qì duō me rè tā dōu jiān chí měi tiān pǎo wǔ gōng lǐ
en: No matter how hot the weather is, he keeps running five kilometres every day.
why: 不管 with the question form 多么热 takes 都. 就 and 才 are not the partners of 不管, and 但是 cannot follow 不管.

q: 无论医生怎么劝，爷爷___不肯住院。
zh: 无论医生怎么劝，爷爷都不肯住院。
py: wú lùn yī shēng zěn me quàn yé ye dōu bù kěn zhù yuàn
en: No matter how the doctor urges him, Grandpa refuses to go into hospital.
why: 无论 plus 怎么 (a question word) takes 都 before the verb. 才 would mean "only then", 越 needs a second 越, and 但是 cannot follow 无论.

q: 不管___累，她每天晚上都要锻炼半小时。
zh: 不管多累，她每天晚上都要锻炼半小时。
py: bù guǎn duō lèi tā měi tiān wǎn shang dōu yào duàn liàn bàn xiǎo shí
en: However tired she is, she exercises for half an hour every night.
why: 不管 needs a question form, and 多 + adjective ("how tired") is one. 很, 太 and 非常 make a plain statement, which cannot follow 不管.

q: 除了每天吃药以外，医生___要求他每周去医院检查一次。
zh: 除了每天吃药以外，医生还要求他每周去医院检查一次。
py: chú le měi tiān chī yào yǐ wài yī shēng hái yāo qiú tā měi zhōu qù yī yuàn jiǎn chá yī cì
en: Besides taking medicine every day, the doctor also requires him to go to the hospital for a check once a week.
why: Taking medicine and the weekly check are two things added together, so 以外 is followed by 还. 都 would mean "except", which contradicts the cue.

q: 不管是感冒___发烧，他都坚持上班。
zh: 不管是感冒还是发烧，他都坚持上班。
py: bù guǎn shì gǎn mào hái shì fā shāo tā dōu jiān chí shàng bān
en: Whether it is a cold or a fever, he still goes to work.
why: 不管 needs two open alternatives, which are joined by 还是. 而是 means "but rather", 而且 means "and moreover" and 所以 means "so", none of which joins alternatives.

q: 这个西瓜___大又甜，夏天吃最好了。
zh: 这个西瓜又大又甜，夏天吃最好了。
py: zhè ge xī guā yòu dà yòu tián xià tiān chī zuì hǎo le
en: This watermelon is both big and sweet, perfect to eat in summer.
why: Two qualities of one thing are joined by 又…又, so the first slot must also be 又. 也, 还 and 再 cannot start the pair before an adjective.

q: 他不但嗓子疼，___还发烧了。
zh: 他不但嗓子疼，而且还发烧了。
py: tā bù dàn sǎng zi téng ér qiě hái fā shāo le
en: Not only does his throat hurt, he also has a fever now.
why: 不但 pairs with 而且, which adds a second point and sits before 还. 但是, 所以 and 因为 do not continue an addition.

q: 我喜欢一边听音乐，___做运动。
zh: 我喜欢一边听音乐，一边做运动。
py: wǒ xǐ huan yī biān tīng yīn yuè yī biān zuò yùn dòng
en: I like to listen to music while I exercise.
why: Two actions at the same time are 一边…一边, so the second slot must be 一边 too. 又 would join qualities, and 越 and 才 do not fit.

q: 这种药既苦，___贵，我不想吃。
zh: 这种药既苦，又贵，我不想吃。
py: zhè zhǒng yào jì kǔ yòu guì wǒ bù xiǎng chī
en: This medicine is both bitter and expensive, so I don't want to take it.
why: 既 pairs with 又 (or 也) to join two qualities. 就 and 才 are not partners of 既, and 但是 would make the second quality a contrast.

q: 不但弟弟爱运动，妹妹___常常陪他去跑步。
zh: 不但弟弟爱运动，妹妹也常常陪他去跑步。
py: bù dàn dì di ài yùn dòng mèi mei yě cháng cháng péi tā qù pǎo bù
en: Not only does my brother love sports, my sister often goes jogging with him too.
why: When the two clauses have different subjects, the second clause takes 也 after its subject 妹妹. 才 would mean "only then", and 但是 and 因此 are conjunctions that do not follow 不但 here.

q: 雨___下___大，我们只好在山下的小店里等着。
zh: 雨越下越大，我们只好在山下的小店里等着。
py: yǔ yuè xià yuè dà wǒ men zhǐ hǎo zài shān xià de xiǎo diàn lǐ děng zhe
en: The rain was falling harder and harder, so we had no choice but to wait in a little shop at the foot of the hill.
why: 越…越 describes one thing growing with another: more rain falling, heavier rain. 又…又 joins qualities, 一边…一边 joins two separate actions, and 不但…而且 adds a point.

q: 天气___冷了，大家都穿上了厚衣服。
zh: 天气越来越冷了，大家都穿上了厚衣服。
py: tiān qì yuè lái yuè lěng le dà jiā dōu chuān shàng le hòu yī fu
en: The weather is getting colder and colder, and everybody has put on thick clothes.
why: Change over time with an adjective is 越来越. 一边 and 又 and 才 cannot build a "more and more" meaning here.

q: 春天来了，白天___来越长了。
zh: 春天来了，白天越来越长了。
py: chūn tiān lái le bái tiān yuè lái yuè cháng le
en: Spring is here and the days are getting longer and longer.
why: 越来越 is a fixed unit, so the slot before 来 must be 越. 更 or 又 cannot be followed by 来越 in this pattern.

q: 你越着急，病好得___慢。
zh: 你越着急，病好得越慢。
py: nǐ yuè zháo jí bìng hǎo de yuè màn
en: The more anxious you are, the more slowly you get better.
why: 越 A 越 B needs a second 越 for the result: the more anxious, the slower. 很 would break the pair, and 就 and 才 do not complete it.

q: 冬天过去了，天气___暖和，公园里的人也越来越多了。
zh: 冬天过去了，天气越来越暖和，公园里的人也越来越多了。
py: dōng tiān guò qù le tiān qì yuè lái yuè nuǎn huo gōng yuán lǐ de rén yě yuè lái yuè duō le
en: Winter is over, the weather is getting warmer and warmer, and there are more and more people in the park.
why: The sentence describes a change over time with an adjective, so 越来越 is needed. A bare 越 needs a second 越, and 更 and 最 do not show gradual change.

q: 这种药你吃得越多，对身体___不好。
zh: 这种药你吃得越多，对身体越不好。
py: zhè zhǒng yào nǐ chī de yuè duō duì shēn tǐ yuè bù hǎo
en: The more of this medicine you take, the worse it is for your body.
why: 吃得越多 starts the pair, so the result also needs 越. 很 would leave 越 without its partner, and 就 and 才 are not in this pattern.

q: 我不是感冒了，___是过敏了。
zh: 我不是感冒了，而是过敏了。
py: wǒ bú shì gǎn mào le ér shì guò mǐn le
en: It is not that I have a cold; I have an allergy.
why: The first part is denied and then corrected, so the pair is 不是…而是. 就是 would say it is always one of the two, which does not match a correction.

q: 他最近不是咳嗽，___是发烧，一直没好。
zh: 他最近不是咳嗽，就是发烧，一直没好。
py: tā zuì jìn bú shì ké sou jiù shì fā shāo yì zhí méi hǎo
en: Lately he is always either coughing or running a fever and has not got better.
why: The cue says he keeps having one or the other, which is 不是…就是. 而是 would mean "not A but B", a single correction.

q: 周末你自己选：___去爬山，___在家休息。
zh: 周末你自己选：要么去爬山，要么在家休息。
py: zhōu mò nǐ zì jǐ xuǎn ： yào me qù pá shān yào me zài jiā xiū xi
en: Choose for yourself this weekend: either go hiking or rest at home.
why: "You choose" offers alternatives to pick from, so 要么…要么. 不是…就是 describes what always happens, 不但…而且 adds, and 因为…所以 states a cause.

q: 他周末不是看电视，___是睡觉，哪儿也不去。
zh: 他周末不是看电视，就是睡觉，哪儿也不去。
py: tā zhōu mò bú shì kàn diàn shì jiù shì shuì jiào nǎ r yě bù qù
en: At weekends he is either watching TV or sleeping and goes nowhere.
why: The cue says it is always one of the two, which is 不是…就是. 而是 would deny watching TV and replace it with sleeping on one occasion.

q: 你想怎么治？___吃药，___打针，你自己决定。
zh: 你想怎么治？要么吃药，要么打针，你自己决定。
py: nǐ xiǎng zěn me zhì yào me chī yào yào me dǎ zhēn nǐ zì jǐ jué dìng
en: How do you want to be treated? Either take medicine or have an injection; it is up to you.
why: Two options for the listener to choose between are 要么…要么. 不是…就是 would describe a habit, and 既…又 would mean doing both.

q: 我一回到家，___觉得头疼。
zh: 我一回到家，就觉得头疼。
py: wǒ yī huí dào jiā jiù jué de tóu téng
en: As soon as I got home, I felt a headache coming on.
why: 一 + verb takes 就 for the second event right after. 才 would mean "only then", and 还 or 再 do not express "immediately".

q: 我们先去医院看医生，___去药店买药。
zh: 我们先去医院看医生，然后去药店买药。
py: wǒ men xiān qù yī yuàn kàn yī shēng rán hòu qù yào diàn mǎi yào
en: We'll first go to the hospital to see a doctor, and then go to the pharmacy to buy the medicine.
why: 先 starts the sequence and 然后 begins the next step. 因此 would claim a cause, 但是 a contrast, and 越 needs a second 越.

q: 一到秋天，北京的天气___变得干燥起来。
zh: 一到秋天，北京的天气就变得干燥起来。
py: yī dào qiū tiān běi jīng de tiān qì jiù biàn de gān zào qǐ lái
en: As soon as autumn arrives, the weather in Beijing starts to turn dry.
why: 一 + verb is completed by 就 after the second subject. 才 would say "not until", 越 needs a second 越, and 但是 is a contrast word.

q: 你___把手洗干净，再给孩子喂药。
zh: 你先把手洗干净，再给孩子喂药。
py: nǐ xiān bǎ shǒu xǐ gān jìng zài gěi hái zi wèi yào
en: First wash your hands clean, then give the child the medicine.
why: 再 marks step two, so step one needs 先. 就 or 才 do not set up an order of steps, and 越 needs a second 越.

zh: 我一回家就想睡觉。
py: wǒ yī huí jiā jiù xiǎng shuì jiào
en: As soon as I get home I want to sleep.
why: 一 stays right before the first verb and 就 follows the second subject. 就 cannot open the clause before 我.

zh: 如果你头疼，我就陪你去医院。
py: rú guǒ nǐ tóu téng wǒ jiù péi nǐ qù yī yuàn
en: If you have a headache, I will go to the hospital with you.
why: The if-clause comes first and 就 follows the second subject 我. Putting 就 before 我 is the classic error.

zh: 虽然外面下着大雪，但是他还是去跑步了。
py: suī rán wài miàn xià zhe dà xuě dàn shì tā hái shì qù pǎo bù le
en: Although it is snowing hard outside, he still went running.
why: 虽然 opens the fact and 但是 comes before the subject 他, while 还是 is an adverb that follows 他.

zh: 只有多喝水，病才会好得快。
py: zhǐ yǒu duō hē shuǐ bìng cái huì hǎo de kuài
en: Only if you drink lots of water will the illness get better quickly.
why: 只有 names the one condition and its partner 才 follows the second subject 病, not the opener.

zh: 不管多冷，奶奶都要出去散步。
py: bù guǎn duō lěng nǎi nai dōu yào chū qù sàn bù
en: However cold it is, Grandma goes out for a walk.
why: 不管 takes a question form (多冷) and 都 follows the subject of the main clause, directly before the verb phrase.

zh: 除了发烧，他还觉得喉咙很疼。
py: chú le fā shāo tā hái jué de hóu long hěn téng
en: Besides having a fever, he also feels that his throat hurts a lot.
why: 除了 A with 还 adds a second item, and 还 sits after the subject 他, directly before 觉得.

zh: 天气越来越热了。
py: tiān qì yuè lái yuè rè le
en: The weather is getting hotter and hotter.
why: 越来越 goes before the adjective and 了 closes the clause. 很 cannot be added after 越来越.

zh: 她一边咳嗽，一边做饭。
py: tā yī biān ké sou yī biān zuò fàn
en: She is coughing while cooking.
why: Two simultaneous actions are 一边 + verb, 一边 + verb, after the shared subject 她.

zh: 既然天气这么好，我们就去公园走走吧。
py: jì rán tiān qì zhè me hǎo wǒ men jiù qù gōng yuán zǒu zǒu ba
en: Since the weather is so nice, let's go for a walk in the park.
why: 既然 states the known fact and 就 follows the subject 我们 in the suggestion. 就 cannot come before 我们.

zh: 即使明天下大雪，我们也不会取消比赛。
py: jí shǐ míng tiān xià dà xuě wǒ men yě bú huì qǔ xiāo bǐ sài
en: Even if it snows heavily tomorrow, we will not cancel the match.
why: 即使 supposes a case and its partner 也 comes after the second subject 我们. 但是 is not used.

zh: 我先洗澡，然后睡觉。
py: wǒ xiān xǐ zǎo rán hòu shuì jiào
en: I'll take a shower first and then go to sleep.
why: 先 stands after the subject and before the first verb, and 然后 begins the next step.

zh: 这家医院不但医生好，而且环境也很干净。
py: zhè jiā yī yuàn bù dàn yī shēng hǎo ér qiě huán jìng yě hěn gān jìng
en: This hospital has not only good doctors, but a very clean environment too.
why: 不但 and 而且 pair up; the subject can stand before or after 不但 because both clauses are about the same hospital.

zh: 这个月不是下雨，就是刮风。
py: zhè ge yuè bú shì xià yǔ jiù shì guā fēng
en: This month it is either raining or windy.
why: 不是 A 就是 B says that it is always one of the two. 这个月 stays at the front.

zh: 我不是不想去医院，而是今天实在没有时间。
py: wǒ bú shì bù xiǎng qù yī yuàn ér shì jīn tiān shí zài méi yǒu shí jiān
en: It is not that I don't want to go to the hospital; I just really have no time today.
why: 不是 denies the first idea and 而是 introduces the correct explanation after it.

zh: 如果下雪，我就在家看书。
py: rú guǒ xià xuě wǒ jiù zài jiā kàn shū
en: If it snows, I will read at home.
why: 如果 opens the first clause, and 就 stays directly in front of the verb phrase after the second subject 我.

zh: 他一吃辣的就流鼻涕。
py: tā yī chī là de jiù liú bí tì
en: Whenever he eats spicy food his nose runs.
why: 一 + verb then 就: the second action follows right away. 就 stays right before the second verb.

zh: 尽管医生反复提醒，他还是没有戒烟。
py: jǐn guǎn yī shēng fǎn fù tí xǐng tā hái shì méi yǒu jiè yān
en: Even though the doctor reminded him again and again, he still did not give up smoking.
why: 尽管 states a real fact and its usual partner 还是 sits after the subject 他.

zh: 只要每天锻炼，你就会越来越健康。
py: zhǐ yào měi tiān duàn liàn nǐ jiù huì yuè lái yuè jiàn kāng
en: As long as you exercise every day, you will get healthier and healthier.
why: 只要 gives the sufficient condition and 就 follows the subject 你. The subject may also come before 只要.

zh: 无论冬天还是夏天，他都坚持洗冷水澡。
py: wú lùn dōng tiān hái shì xià tiān tā dōu jiān chí xǐ lěng shuǐ zǎo
en: Whether in winter or in summer, he keeps taking cold showers.
why: 无论 plus A 还是 B takes 都 after the subject 他, directly before the verb.

zh: 雨越下越大。
py: yǔ yuè xià yuè dà
en: The rain is getting heavier and heavier.
why: 越 + verb + 越 + adjective: the rain falls and the more it falls, the heavier it gets.

src: 他很累，他还是去上班了。
src_py: tā hěn lèi tā hái shì qù shàng bān le
task: Join the two clauses with 虽然…但是.
zh: 他虽然很累，但是还是去上班了。
py: tā suī rán hěn lèi dàn shì hái shì qù shàng bān le
en: Although he is tired, he still went to work.
why: 虽然 opens the fact (before or after 他) and 但是 comes before 还是, which follows the subject.

src: 我喝了热水，觉得舒服多了。
src_py: wǒ hē le rè shuǐ jué de shū fu duō le
zh: 我一喝热水就觉得舒服多了。
py: wǒ yī hē rè shuǐ jiù jué de shū fu duō le
en: As soon as I drink hot water I feel much better.
why: 一 goes right before the first verb and 就 right before the second, both after the subject 我.

src: 不下雨的话，我们就去爬山。
src_py: bù xià yǔ de huà wǒ men jiù qù pá shān
zh: 只要不下雨，我们就去爬山。
py: zhǐ yào bù xià yǔ wǒ men jiù qù pá shān
en: As long as it doesn't rain, we'll go hiking.
why: 只要 opens the sufficient condition and 就 follows the second subject 我们.

src: 他喜欢游泳，也喜欢打篮球。
src_py: tā xǐ huan yóu yǒng yě xǐ huan dǎ lán qiú
task: Rewrite with 除了…以外 and 还.
zh: 除了游泳以外，他还喜欢打篮球。
py: chú le yóu yǒng yǐ wài tā hái xǐ huan dǎ lán qiú
en: Besides swimming, he also likes playing basketball.
why: 除了…以外 with 还 adds an item, and 还 sits after the subject 他.

task: Say it is getting colder and colder.
zh: 天气越来越冷了。
py: tiān qì yuè lái yuè lěng le
en: The weather is getting colder and colder.
why: 越来越 + adjective + 了 shows a change over time with no 很.

s: 如果你头疼，就我们去医院吧。
zh: 如果你头疼，我们就去医院吧。
s_py: rú guǒ nǐ tóu téng jiù wǒ men qù yī yuàn ba
py: rú guǒ nǐ tóu téng wǒ men jiù qù yī yuàn ba
en: If you have a headache, let's go to the hospital.
why: 就 is an adverb and must follow the second subject 我们. Putting it in front of 我们 is the classic error.

s: 不管天气冷，他都去游泳。
zh: 不管天气冷不冷，他都去游泳。
s_py: bù guǎn tiān qì lěng tā dōu qù yóu yǒng
py: bù guǎn tiān qì lěng bù lěng tā dōu qù yóu yǒng
en: Whether the weather is cold or not, he goes swimming.
why: 不管 needs a question form (冷不冷). A plain statement cannot follow it.

s: 我的咳嗽越来越非常严重了。
zh: 我的咳嗽越来越严重了。
s_py: wǒ de ké sou yuè lái yuè fēi cháng yán zhòng le
py: wǒ de ké sou yuè lái yuè yán zhòng le
en: My cough is getting more and more serious.
why: 越来越 already expresses degree, so 非常 cannot follow it.

s: 因为变得更健康，他每天都去游泳。
zh: 为了变得更健康，他每天都去游泳。
s_py: yīn wèi biàn de gèng jiàn kāng tā měi tiān dōu qù yóu yǒng
py: wèi le biàn de gèng jiàn kāng tā měi tiān dōu qù yóu yǒng
en: He swims every day in order to become healthier.
why: Becoming healthier is the aim of the swimming, not a cause, so it needs 为了. 因为 would mean it already happened.

s: 除了星期天，医生每天还在医院。
zh: 除了星期天，医生每天都在医院。
s_py: chú le xīng qī tiān yī shēng měi tiān hái zài yī yuàn
py: chú le xīng qī tiān yī shēng měi tiān dōu zài yī yuàn
en: The doctor is at the hospital every day except Sunday.
why: Sunday is the exception, so the partner is 都. 还 would mean "besides Sunday", which does not fit 每天.

s: 即使明天会下雪，但是我们也要去爬山。
zh: 即使明天会下雪，我们也要去爬山。
s_py: jí shǐ míng tiān huì xià xuě dàn shì wǒ men yě yào qù pá shān
py: jí shǐ míng tiān huì xià xuě wǒ men yě yào qù pá shān
en: Even if it snows tomorrow, we are still going hiking.
why: 即使 pairs with 也, not with 但是, which belongs to 虽然.

s: 你可以选择：要么去看医生，不是在家休息。
zh: 你可以选择：要么去看医生，要么在家休息。
s_py: nǐ kě yǐ xuǎn zé ： yào me qù kàn yī shēng bú shì zài jiā xiū xi
py: nǐ kě yǐ xuǎn zé ： yào me qù kàn yī shēng yào me zài jiā xiū xi
en: You can choose: either see a doctor or rest at home.
why: 要么 pairs with 要么 to offer alternatives. 不是 does not complete it.

s: 只要你不吃甜的，才能控制体重。
zh: 只要你不吃甜的，就能控制体重。
s_py: zhǐ yào nǐ bù chī tián de cái néng kòng zhì tǐ zhòng
py: zhǐ yào nǐ bù chī tián de jiù néng kòng zhì tǐ zhòng
en: As long as you avoid sweet food, you can control your weight.
why: 只要 means this one condition is enough and takes 就. 才 belongs with 只有.

s: 一他吃辣的就咳嗽。
zh: 他一吃辣的就咳嗽。
s_py: yī tā chī là de jiù ké sou
py: tā yī chī là de jiù ké sou
en: He coughs as soon as he eats anything spicy.
why: 一 goes after the subject, right before the first verb. It cannot stand before 他.

s: 这个季节的早上又很冷又很湿。
zh: 这个季节的早上又冷又湿。
s_py: zhè ge jì jié de zǎo shang yòu hěn lěng yòu hěn shī
py: zhè ge jì jié de zǎo shang yòu lěng yòu shī
en: In this season the mornings are both cold and damp.
why: 又…又 joins bare adjectives; 很 cannot be inserted inside the pair.

s: 要是明天不下雪的话，我们就去滑冰。
zh: 要是明天不下雪的话，我们就去滑冰。
py: yào shì míng tiān bù xià xuě de huà wǒ men jiù qù huá bīng
en: If it doesn't snow tomorrow, we'll go ice skating.
why: 要是…的话 with 就 after 我们 is right. 的话 is optional and does not change the partner.

s: 虽然他感冒了，但是他没有请假。
zh: 虽然他感冒了，但是他没有请假。
py: suī rán tā gǎn mào le dàn shì tā méi yǒu qǐng jià
en: Although he caught a cold, he did not take sick leave.
why: 虽然 and 但是 both appear, which is correct. English drops "but", Chinese keeps it.

s: 除了小李，我们都去医院检查了。
zh: 除了小李，我们都去医院检查了。
py: chú le xiǎo lǐ wǒ men dōu qù yī yuàn jiǎn chá le
en: Everyone but Xiao Li went to the hospital for a check-up.
why: 除了 with 都 means "all but", with 我们 as the subject right before 都.

s: 不管明天下不下雨，我们都出发。
zh: 不管明天下不下雨，我们都出发。
py: bù guǎn míng tiān xià bù xià yǔ wǒ men dōu chū fā
en: Whether or not it rains tomorrow, we set off.
why: The A-not-A question 下不下雨 follows 不管, and 都 comes after 我们. This is the standard pattern.

s: 既然已经发烧了，你就别出去了。
zh: 既然已经发烧了，你就别出去了。
py: jì rán yǐ jīng fā shāo le nǐ jiù bié chū qù le
en: Since you already have a fever, don't go out.
why: 既然 takes 就, which follows the second subject 你. 所以 is not needed.

s: 天气越来越暖和，花也越开越多。
zh: 天气越来越暖和，花也越开越多。
py: tiān qì yuè lái yuè nuǎn huo huā yě yuè kāi yuè duō
en: The weather is getting warmer and warmer and more and more flowers are coming out.
why: 越来越 goes with an adjective, and 越开越多 is the 越-verb-越-adjective pattern. Both are correct side by side.

s: 你只有多休息，才会好起来。
zh: 你只有多休息，才会好起来。
py: nǐ zhǐ yǒu duō xiū xi cái huì hǎo qǐ lái
en: Only if you rest a lot will you get better.
why: 只有 takes 才, and the subject 你 may stand before 只有.

s: 他一边洗澡，一边唱歌。
zh: 他一边洗澡，一边唱歌。
py: tā yī biān xǐ zǎo yī biān chàng gē
en: He sings while taking a shower.
why: 洗澡 and 唱歌 are two actions at the same time, so 一边…一边 is correct.

s: 我不但感冒了，而且还发烧了。
zh: 我不但感冒了，而且还发烧了。
py: wǒ bù dàn gǎn mào le ér qiě hái fā shāo le
en: Not only do I have a cold, I also have a fever now.
why: 而且还 together is common: 而且 is the conjunction and 还 an adverb.

s: 就算你不喜欢苦药，你也得吃。
zh: 就算你不喜欢苦药，你也得吃。
py: jiù suàn nǐ bù xǐ huan kǔ yào nǐ yě děi chī
en: Even if you don't like bitter medicine, you have to take it.
why: 就算 pairs with 也 after the second subject 你. 但是 is not needed.

q: 只要多喝热水，感冒___会好的。
zh: 只要多喝热水，感冒就会好的。
py: zhǐ yào duō hē rè shuǐ gǎn mào jiù huì hǎo de
en: As long as you drink plenty of hot water, your cold will get better.
why: 只要 means this one condition is enough, so 就 follows the subject 感冒. 才 would make hot water the only cure, and 但是 and 所以 are conjunctions that do not belong here.

q: 天气一热，他___想吃冰淇淋。
zh: 天气一热，他就想吃冰淇淋。
py: tiān qì yī rè tā jiù xiǎng chī bīng qí lín
en: As soon as the weather turns hot, he wants to eat ice cream.
why: 一 + verb is completed by 就 after the second subject. 才 would say "not until", 再 means "again/then", and 越 needs a second 越.
